hesitant_first_buyer.description: First-time mobile visitor in late 20s, anxious about fit/returns/brand legitimacy, lingering on size charts and returns policy without yet adding to cart.

tabbed_comparison_shopper.description: Multi-tab comparison shopper doing final pricing pass across retailers; knows their style and size, fixated on total cost and shipping.

birthday_rush_gifter.description: Time-pressed gift buyer 2-3 days from a birthday, unsure of recipient's size; prioritizes easy returns, gift wrap, and expedited shipping over price.

post_return_returner.description: Cautious shopper returning after a recent fit failure; obsesses over size chart, return policy, and fit-related reviews before committing again.

outfit_event_planner.description: Event-driven shopper completing an outfit for a specific occasion; style-open, lookbook-loving, less price-sensitive, lingers on 'wear it with' content.

bargain_hunter_returning.description: Loyal returning shopper who only buys on sale; tracks price drops, uses wishlist long-term, checks coupon sites; low size/return anxiety.

premium_silent_browser.description: Mid-thirties premium shopper fixated on one high-end item; needs quality/craftsmanship signals and gentle commit nudges, not peer reviews or alternatives.

paralyzed_wishlister.description: Returning shopper with 20+ wishlist items, oscillating between similar products across multiple visits; decision paralysis dominates, needs a final nudge to commit.

mobile_evening_browser.description: Post-dinner couch scroller on phone; low-engagement casual browsing with wishlist saves, low buy intent, moderate style discovery.

confident_repeat_buyer.description: Loyal 3-4x/year shopper who knows the brand's fit; goes straight to product and adds to cart fast with low anxiety signals across all dimensions.

size_specific_anxious.description: Body-proportion outlier (long torso, athletic, between sizes) who obsesses over size charts and return policies, sizes up cautiously, reads fit reviews exhaustively.

trend_chaser.description: Mobile shopper drawn in by social/celebrity buzz and paid ads; chases the look not the fit, leans on trending/peer cues, weak brand familiarity.

corporate_uniform_buyer.description: Mid-day desktop buyer restocking work basics and suiting; knows what works, values time over price, often buys multiple sizes to keep the best fit.

returner_from_recent_order.description: Returning last week's order while browsing a replacement; knows brand and size from the failure, cautious, drawn to low-return-rate picks and trust signals.
